Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified “Brook Bar” as The Brook pub in Brooklands, Sale, instead of recognizing the historic “Brooks Bar” (a former toll gate) paired with “Trafford Bar” in Manchester. This misinterpretation of the place name (and the “toll gates” context) led the search down the wrong geography, away from the Old Trafford area where Manchester United play.
